build_callgraph_from_trace: build a CallGraph from a Trace object to analyze distributed training execution across ranks and threads
construct_callstackgraph: construct a CallStackGraph from a DataFrame to build a call stack for a single CPU thread or GPU stream
infer_device_type: infer whether a trace DataFrame represents CPU or GPU device based on stream values
compare_events: compare two Event namedtuples to determine their ordering for sorting events in a call stack
dfs_traverse_callstack: perform depth-first traversal on a CallStackGraph calling enter and exit callback functions on each node
